subject: Price notice - EPDM 70 compound
body:
Hello,

Due to continued increases in ethylene and diene feedstock costs, our EPDM 70 duro compound will move from $2.10/lb to $2.27/lb effective November 1, 2026. All other EPDM grades are unchanged at this time.

Orders placed before Nov 1 ship at current pricing.

Regards,
Dana Whitfield
Midwest Polymer Supply

subject: Nitrile 70 pricing update
body:
Hi team,

Effective 15 November 2026 the price for our NBR 70 (Buna-N 70) compound will be USD 5.20 per kg. This reflects the acrylonitrile increases we flagged last quarter.

Please let me know if you want to place forward orders.

Thanks,
Marco Iles
Great Lakes Elastomers

gold.trap: priced per kg; catalog is per lb

subject: VMQ 50 bag pricing - Nov 1
body:

Starting November 1, 2026, Silicone VMQ 50 will be invoiced at $310.00 per 25 kg bag (currently $281.10 per bag). Pallet quantities are unchanged at 40 bags.

Best,
Priya Raman
Summit Silicones

subject: Holiday shipping schedule
body:
Hello valued customer,

Our warehouse will be closed November 26-27 and December 24 - January 1. Orders received after December 18 will ship on January 4. Pricing and lead times are otherwise unchanged.

Happy holidays,
Summit Silicones

subject: FKM 75 - 2026 Q4 adjustment
body:
Dear customer,

Please be advised that FKM 75 (Viton 75 equivalent) will increase by 6.5% effective December 1, 2026, due to HFP and VDF monomer costs. Your current contract price remains in place until that date.

Sincerely,
FluoroTech Materials Commercial Team
